body.estimand_functional: \(\tau=\mathbb E\{h(W,1)-h(W,0)\}\) when a fortified outcome bridge exists and the actual-law proximal assumptions hold

sampling_model.design: An observational finite-categorical proxy structural causal model with declared support \(S\) and factor-table parameter \(\theta\in\Theta_S\), with no baseline \(X\) or interpreted within one fixed \(X\)-stratum.
sampling_model.units: Independent draws from one compatible law \(P_\theta\); sampling inference is not part of the rank kernel.
sampling_model.overlap: Every cell in \(S\) and every latent state conditional on that cell has strictly positive probability; cells outside \(S\) are structural zeros.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No nuisance estimator is assumed. The proposal characterizes algebraic feasibility of the fortified completeness premise, not estimation of \(h\).

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The general \(L_2\) model with baseline \(X\) uses fortified supply \(\mathcal H_\gamma+L_2(Z_{-\alpha^*},X)\), and its no-baseline ternary illustration displays a \(12\times15\) matrix.
Two categorical proxies identify causal effects when the relevant observed conditional-probability matrix has sufficient rank.
A family has an independent transversal if and only if every subfamily satisfies the corresponding rank inequality.
Algebraic arguments establish generic identifiability for several finite latent product models outside exceptional varieties.
A combinatorial polynomial-time algorithm computes symbolic rank for generic partitioned matrices with \(2\times2\) coefficient blocks.
A minimax rank theorem applies to a restricted class of generic partitioned matrices.
Integer-valued submodular functions can be minimized with strongly polynomially many value-oracle calls.

body.tldr: The Hall defect \(\eta(S)\), together with the block-constant loss \(\kappa_0(S)\), gives generic rank \(Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)\) for the finite compatible positive factor-table model. The sharper headline is an elbow between generic and law-uniform conclusions: support can certify generic feasibility, but when \(u\geq2\) the positive uniform latent tables have rank at most \(|\mathcal I_S|<Q_S\), so no nonempty support or alphabet pattern can certify actual-law completeness. For \(u=1\), law-uniform rank has an exact finite sign-feasibility characterization. The defect is computable by an exact rank-oracle reduction, and none of these structural conclusions alone supplies bridge existence, actual-law completeness, or identification of \(\tau\).

project_justification.gap: Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen formulate fortified completeness in general \(L_2\) spaces with baseline \(X\), while categorical proxy theory states rank conditions at a law. Neither gives a structural-zero Hall characterization, separates generic feasibility from support-only law-uniform guarantees, or corrects the dimension loss in the cited finite ternary display.
project_justification.niche: For coordinate-specific finite alphabets and a declared support, multiplication by the positive observed cell mass converts fortified moments into a support-incidence space. After quotienting block constants, the latent contrasts form a replicated subspace-transversal problem, while the positive uniform tables expose a law-level obstruction invisible to support counts.
project_justification.fill: The paper proves the product-block Rado attainment, the exact generic rank and Hall frontier, the \(u=1\) versus \(u\geq2\) law-uniform elbow, and an exact oracle-model defect computation using strongly polynomially many quotient-rank-oracle calls with exact rational-function elimination per call. It also internally derives the no-baseline ternary anchor count \(12\times16\) and shows that the complete supply has one more dimension than the cited \(12\times15\) display, without attributing a specific omitted basis vector to the source. It makes no polynomial bit-complexity claim.

body.related_work: Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen work in general \(L_2\) spaces with baseline \(X\), defining \(\mathcal H_\gamma=\{d:\mathbb E(d\mid Z_{-\nu},X)=0\text{ for every }|\nu|=\gamma\}\) and using fortified supply \(\mathcal H_\gamma+L_2(Z_{-\alpha^*},X)\). Their Remark 2.3 supplies the exact \(12\times15\) full-rank display recorded in the narrowed cited anchor-display lemma. The direct specialization here independently derives thirteen fortified dimensions and three complement-proxy dimensions with zero intersection, so the complete pairing is \(12\times16\); it is generically full rank but deficient at the uniform-table law. The quadratic complement function is an internally exhibited third direction, not a basis omission attributed to the source. This calculation is finite categorical and has no \(X\), or applies within a fixed \(X\)-stratum. The negative result transfers only by inclusion: because this finite full-support model is a subclass of the broader anchor class, no theorem based only on support and alphabet sizes can guarantee law-uniform fortified completeness over that broader class when \(u\geq2\). The positive generic result is not claimed for continuous or \(X\)-varying laws without a pointwise-almost-everywhere extension. Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen provide the categorical matrix-rank foundation but no structural-zero support theorem. Rado supplies the independent-transversal theorem adapted to the product-block quotient. Iwata and Murota and Hirai and Iwamasa concern different generic partitioned-matrix parameterizations. Allman, Matias, and Rhodes motivate the distinction between generic and global identification. Wang and Kuo motivate support-compatible discrete laws. Schrijver supplies only the value-oracle submodular-minimization engine. Cui and coauthors and Zhang and coauthors clarify that actual-law completeness and bridge uniqueness are logically distinct from identification of the causal functional.
body.interpretation: The structural support answers whether full rank is attainable generically, not whether it holds at the realized law. For every nondegenerate latent alphabet \(u\geq2\), the compatible positive model always contains uniform latent tables that collapse the \(u\) columns in each supported \((A,C)\) block to one direction. The degenerate elbow \(u=1\) is different: exact law-uniform rank is decided by whether the incidence row space contains a block-constant vector whose treatment coordinates can be canceled by positive block masses.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The defect algorithm is exact in the quotient-rank-oracle model: submodular minimization makes strongly polynomially many oracle calls, and each call is implemented by exact elimination over \(\mathbb F_S\). This does not establish polynomial bit complexity for representing or eliminating arbitrary rational functions, and the returned \(I^*\) is an exact maximizing deficient subset rather than a standalone succinct maximality certificate. The inherited nine-cell and \(135\)-case computations remain non-load-bearing because no support encodings or reproducible script were supplied.
body.honest_scope: The results concern finite coordinate-specific proxy alphabets, a declared support, and no baseline \(X\), or one fixed \(X\)-stratum. They give generic feasibility, law-uniform route failure, a sign characterization at \(u=1\), and an exact oracle reduction. The finite full-support subclass refutes any support/alphabet-only law-uniform completeness guarantee over the broader Yu--Shi--Tchetgen Tchetgen class when \(u\geq2\), but the positive generic theorem is not transferred to continuous or \(X\)-varying laws. Even at a generically feasible support, fortified completeness must hold at the actual law, a fortified outcome bridge must exist, and all remaining proximal causal assumptions must hold before \(\tau=\mathbb E[Y(1)-Y(0)]\) equals \(\mathbb E\{h(W,1)-h(W,0)\}\). Failure of this pairing route does not prove that \(\tau\) is unidentified by every route. The rectangular equal-alphabet theorem remains only a special case of the support Hall result.
